name: Webinar / Virtual Class
description: Summarize online teaching sessions, webinars, and virtual classes with key concepts, participant questions, and follow-up resources.

sections.title: Session Overview
sections.instruction: Provide a concise overview of the session topic, intended audience, and primary outcome or purpose of the webinar or class.

sections.title: Presenters & Audience
sections.instruction: List the presenters, moderators, guest speakers, and any clearly identified audience groups or participants mentioned during the session.

sections.title: Agenda & Learning Objectives
sections.instruction: Summarize the planned agenda, learning goals, or key outcomes the presenter said attendees should understand by the end.

sections.title: Key Concepts & Demonstrations
sections.instruction: Capture the main concepts taught, examples shown, demonstrations performed, and any frameworks, workflows, or methods explained.

sections.title: Participant Questions & Answers
sections.instruction: List the most important audience questions and the presenter responses. Include unresolved questions if they were deferred.

sections.title: Resources Shared
sections.instruction: List any links, documents, tools, homework, readings, downloads, or references mentioned as follow-up resources.

sections.title: Assignments & Next Steps
sections.instruction: List any assignments, practice tasks, deadlines, follow-up actions, or next session commitments mentioned. Include owners when they are clear.
